name: Cut In Wall at Trim Edges
intent: Wall painter establishes the wall-to-trim brush line along baseboard tops, door casing edges, and window casing edges. Same brush technique regardless of whether the wall field is sprayed + backrolled, sprayed only, or brushed + rolled. Fires once per coat.
doctrine: Cut-in to trim is a brush task independent of the wall field method. Previously bundled inside MOD_APPLY_WALL_SPRAY_BACKROLL / _SPRAY_ONLY / _ROLL as separate task variants at identical 120 LF/hr rates; consolidated into this standalone module 2026-04-18 so the cut-in rate is tunable in one place. Coat 1 at baseline (120 LF/hr); coat 2 runs 25% faster (150 LF/hr effective) because the painter follows the line already established on coat 1. TRIM_EDGES ps_key is the sum of baseboard + door casing + window casing LF — appropriate here because cut-in actually happens at every trim edge.
